dedupe_keys.name: data for future global electricity demand load curves

description: Data for: Future global electricity demand load curves is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Victhalia Zapata. In this research, hourly electricity demand is modelled within the integrated assessment model (IAM) IMAGE and under the SSP2 baseline scenario for the future. The hourly demand patterns shown in this dataset correspond to the end-uses that have a climate dependence for electricity demand at the hourly and monthly resolution. Coverage: global; the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
